g.text: Changing a selected mode replaces that stage's
mode-specific settings and removes later therapy stages.
Initial-to-final pressure titration remains within a stage.
Require at least one equipment change
and a reason for the change
A later equipment stage must change mask type,
mask size, chin strap, or heated humidity.
Missing, repeated, or invalid stage details
Keep form open and show field errors
Add or remove mask type or size
The working note is edited in the browser surface.
Medication, protocol, and AI actions are separate
explicit tools that can insert reviewed content.
